summary: Use Fractal naming in core runtime guidance and diagnostics

replay.detail: Mechanical wording and private identifier changes; existing claims replay unchanged.

schema.detail: Wire names, persisted kinds and database tables and columns are unchanged.

rules.detail: No reconciliation or admission rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Existing environment bridges, cross-process identities, installed paths, service labels, thread labels and telemetry keys remain unchanged. Frozen messaging and client surfaces are excluded; wording and test names consumed by frozen assertions or inventories retain their existing spelling.

downtime.detail: No host cutover or service migration.

recovery.detail: No durable state changes or recovery steps.
